sentences.en: When I was fifteen, I failed an important math exam.
sentences.cn: 十五岁时，我一次重要的数学考试没及格。

sentences.en: At first, I felt so ashamed that I wanted to give up.
sentences.cn: 起初，我羞愧得想要放弃。

sentences.en: My teacher noticed my low spirits and talked to me after class.
sentences.cn: 老师注意到我情绪低落，课后找我谈话。

sentences.en: "Failure is not the opposite of success," she said. "It is part of it."
sentences.cn: “失败不是成功的反面，”她说，“它是成功的一部分。”

sentences.en: Her words encouraged me to look at my mistakes carefully.
sentences.cn: 她的话鼓励我去认真审视自己的错误。

sentences.en: I began to review every problem I had got wrong.
sentences.cn: 我开始复习每一道做错的题。

sentences.en: Gradually, I understood the topics that had confused me.
sentences.cn: 渐渐地，我弄懂了曾经困扰我的知识点。

sentences.en: In the next exam, I made great progress and even enjoyed math.
sentences.cn: 在下一次考试中，我取得了很大进步，甚至开始喜欢数学了。

sentences.en: Now I believe that every failure hides a chance to grow.
sentences.cn: 如今我相信，每一次失败都藏着一个成长的机会。

questions.q: How old was the writer when he failed the exam? (用数字回答)
According to the teacher, failure is part of ______ .
What did the writer review after the talk? (每道做错的 ______)
questions.tip: review every problem I had got wrong

sentences.en: One cold winter evening, I missed the last bus home.
sentences.cn: 一个寒冷的冬夜，我错过了回家的末班车。

sentences.en: I stood at the empty stop, worried and freezing.
sentences.cn: 我站在空荡荡的车站，又担心又冻得发抖。

sentences.en: An old man walking his dog stopped and asked what was wrong.
sentences.cn: 一位遛狗的老人停下来，问我出了什么事。

sentences.en: After hearing my story, he offered to drive me home.
sentences.cn: 听完我的经历后，他主动提出开车送我回家。

sentences.en: I hesitated, but his kind smile made me feel safe.
sentences.cn: 我犹豫了一下，但他和善的微笑让我感到安心。

sentences.en: On the way, he told me that strangers had once helped him too.
sentences.cn: 路上，他告诉我，从前也曾有陌生人帮助过他。

sentences.en: "Kindness should be passed on," he said with a warm voice.
sentences.cn: “善意应该被传递下去，”他用温暖的声音说。

sentences.en: That night I learned that a small act can light up someone's world.
sentences.cn: 那晚我懂得，一个小小的举动就能照亮别人的世界。

questions.q: Why couldn't the writer go home at first? (missed the last ______)
Who offered to help the writer?
questions.a: an old man/the old man/old man
questions.tip: An old man walking his dog

questions.q: What should be passed on according to the old man?

items.title: How AI Is Changing Our Lives

sentences.en: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is no longer science fiction.
sentences.cn: 人工智能（AI）不再是科幻小说里的东西。

sentences.en: It is already part of our daily lives in many ways.
sentences.cn: 它已经以多种方式成为我们日常生活的一部分。

sentences.en: When you search online, AI helps decide which results you see.
sentences.cn: 当你上网搜索时，AI 帮助决定你看到哪些结果。

sentences.en: Smart assistants can set alarms, answer questions and play music.
sentences.cn: 智能助手可以设置闹钟、回答问题并播放音乐。

sentences.en: In hospitals, AI helps doctors read images and find diseases earlier.
sentences.cn: 在医院里，AI 帮助医生读片、更早发现疾病。

sentences.en: However, the rise of AI also brings new challenges.
sentences.cn: 然而，AI 的兴起也带来了新的挑战。

sentences.en: Some people worry that machines may replace human workers.
sentences.cn: 有些人担心机器可能会取代人类工人。

sentences.en: Experts argue that we should learn to work together with AI.
sentences.cn: 专家认为，我们应当学会与 AI 协作。

sentences.en: Used wisely, AI can free us to do more creative work.
sentences.cn: 如果使用得当，AI 能把我们解放出来去做更有创造性的工作。

questions.q: What does AI stand for? (Artificial ______)
In hospitals, AI helps doctors read ______ and find diseases earlier.
Experts think we should learn to ______ with AI. (work ______)

items.title: Should Students Use Smartphones at School?

sentences.en: Whether students should use smartphones at school is widely debated.
sentences.cn: 学生是否应在学校使用智能手机，人们对此争论不休。

sentences.en: Those in favour say phones are useful learning tools.
sentences.cn: 支持者认为手机是有用的学习工具。

sentences.en: With a phone, students can look up information instantly.
sentences.cn: 有了手机，学生可以即时查阅信息。

sentences.en: They can also stay in touch with their parents when necessary.
sentences.cn: 必要时他们还能与父母保持联系。

sentences.en: On the other hand, opponents point out serious problems.
sentences.cn: 另一方面，反对者指出了严重的问题。

sentences.en: Phones can easily distract students from their studies.
sentences.cn: 手机很容易使学生从学习中分心。

sentences.en: Moreover, spending too long on screens may harm their health.
sentences.cn: 而且，屏幕使用时间过长可能损害他们的健康。

sentences.en: In my opinion, phones should be allowed but properly managed.
sentences.cn: 在我看来，手机应被允许使用，但要妥善管理。

sentences.en: Only in this way can we enjoy the benefits while avoiding the harm.
sentences.cn: 只有这样，我们才能享受好处、同时避免危害。

questions.q: Supporters think phones are useful learning ______ .
One problem is that phones can ______ students from their studies.
The writer's opinion: phones should be allowed but properly ______ .

sentences.en: The Spring Festival is the most important holiday in China.
sentences.cn: 春节是中国最重要的节日。

sentences.en: It marks the beginning of a new year on the lunar calendar.
sentences.cn: 它标志着农历新年的开始。

sentences.en: Before the festival, families clean their houses thoroughly.
sentences.cn: 节前，家家户户都要彻底打扫房屋。

sentences.en: People put up red couplets and paper cuttings for good luck.
sentences.cn: 人们贴上红色的对联和剪纸以求好运。

sentences.en: On New Year's Eve, the whole family gathers for a big dinner.
sentences.cn: 除夕夜，全家团聚，共进丰盛的晚餐。

sentences.en: Children receive lucky money in red envelopes from their elders.
sentences.cn: 孩子们会收到长辈装在红包里的压岁钱。

sentences.en: Fireworks light up the sky to drive away bad luck.
sentences.cn: 烟花点亮天空，以驱走厄运。

sentences.en: Above all, the festival is a time for family and reunion.
sentences.cn: 最重要的是，这个节日是关于家庭与团圆的时刻。

questions.q: The Spring Festival is the most important ______ in China.
Children receive lucky money in red ______ .
Above all, the festival is a time for family and ______ .
questions.tip: a time for family and reunion

sentences.en: The final match of the school sports meeting was about to begin.
sentences.cn: 校运会的最后一场比赛即将开始。

sentences.en: As the last runner of our relay team, I felt the pressure building up.
sentences.cn: 作为接力队的最后一棒，我感到压力越来越大。

sentences.en: When I took the baton, our team was in third place.
sentences.cn: 当我接过接力棒时，我们队排在第三。

sentences.en: I told myself not to give up and pushed forward with all my strength.
sentences.cn: 我告诉自己不要放弃，用尽全力向前冲。

sentences.en: Step by step, I caught up with the runner ahead of me.
sentences.cn: 一步一步，我追上了前面的选手。

sentences.en: The crowd was cheering loudly as I crossed the finish line first.
sentences.cn: 当我第一个冲过终点线时，人群大声欢呼。

sentences.en: We won the race, but what I truly gained was the courage to try.
sentences.cn: 我们赢得了比赛，但我真正收获的是尝试的勇气。

questions.q: What position was the team in when the writer took the baton? (third/______ place)
Who crossed the finish line first?
questions.tip: I crossed the finish line first

questions.q: What did the writer truly gain? (the ______ to try)

sentences.en: Last summer, I got my first part-time job at a small bookshop.
sentences.cn: 去年夏天，我在一家小书店找到了第一份兼职。

sentences.en: At first, I found it hard to remember where every book belonged.
sentences.cn: 起初，我很难记住每本书该放在哪里。

sentences.en: My manager was patient and taught me how to serve customers politely.
sentences.cn: 我的经理很耐心，教我如何礼貌地服务顾客。

sentences.en: One day, an old lady couldn't find a book for her grandson.
sentences.cn: 有一天，一位老太太找不到给孙子的一本书。

sentences.en: I spent half an hour helping her until she left with a big smile.
sentences.cn: 我花了半小时帮她，直到她带着灿烂的微笑离开。

sentences.en: That summer taught me the value of patience and hard work.
sentences.cn: 那个夏天让我懂得了耐心和努力的价值。

questions.q: Where did the writer work? (a ______)
Who taught the writer to serve customers? (the ______)
The summer taught the writer the value of patience and hard ______ .

sentences.en: Many students stay up late, believing they can catch up on sleep later.
sentences.cn: 许多学生熬夜，以为以后可以补觉。

sentences.en: However, scientists say that sleep is essential for the brain.
sentences.cn: 然而，科学家指出睡眠对大脑至关重要。

sentences.en: During sleep, the brain sorts and stores what we have learned.
sentences.cn: 在睡眠中，大脑会整理并储存我们学过的东西。

sentences.en: A lack of sleep can weaken memory and reduce concentration.
sentences.cn: 缺乏睡眠会削弱记忆力、降低注意力。

sentences.en: Teenagers are advised to sleep about eight hours every night.
sentences.cn: 建议青少年每晚睡大约八小时。

sentences.en: Good habits, such as avoiding screens before bed, improve sleep quality.
sentences.cn: 良好的习惯，比如睡前不看屏幕，能提高睡眠质量。

sentences.en: In short, enough sleep is not a waste of time but an investment in health.
sentences.cn: 简言之，充足的睡眠不是浪费时间，而是对健康的投资。

questions.q: During sleep, the brain sorts and ______ what we have learned.
How many hours should teenagers sleep? (about ______)
Enough sleep is an ______ in health.

sentences.en: Bees are small insects, but they play a huge role in nature.
sentences.cn: 蜜蜂是小昆虫，但在自然界中扮演着巨大的角色。

sentences.en: As they move from flower to flower, they carry pollen with them.
sentences.cn: 当它们在花朵间穿梭时，会带走花粉。

sentences.en: This process, called pollination, helps plants produce fruits and seeds.
sentences.cn: 这个过程叫作授粉，能帮助植物结出果实和种子。

sentences.en: About one third of the food we eat depends on bees.
sentences.cn: 我们所吃食物的大约三分之一依赖蜜蜂。

sentences.en: Sadly, the number of bees is falling because of pollution and climate change.
sentences.cn: 遗憾的是，由于污染和气候变化，蜜蜂的数量正在下降。

sentences.en: Scientists warn that protecting bees means protecting our own food supply.
sentences.cn: 科学家警告，保护蜜蜂就是保护我们自己的食物来源。

questions.q: The process by which bees help plants is called ______ .
About one ______ of our food depends on bees. (分数的分母词)
Why is the number of bees falling? (pollution and ______ change)

sentences.en: In recent years, online learning has become increasingly popular.
sentences.cn: 近年来，在线学习越来越流行。

sentences.en: Supporters believe it offers flexibility and saves travelling time.
sentences.cn: 支持者认为它提供了灵活性，并节省了通勤时间。

sentences.en: Students can study at their own pace and review lessons whenever they like.
sentences.cn: 学生可以按自己的节奏学习，随时回看课程。

sentences.en: Critics, however, argue that online learning lacks face-to-face interaction.
sentences.cn: 然而，批评者认为在线学习缺乏面对面的互动。

sentences.en: Without a teacher nearby, some students find it hard to stay focused.
sentences.cn: 身边没有老师，一些学生很难保持专注。

sentences.en: Personally, I think online learning works best as a supplement to classroom teaching.
sentences.cn: 就个人而言，我认为在线学习作为课堂教学的补充最为有效。

sentences.en: By combining both, students can enjoy flexibility without losing guidance.
sentences.cn: 把二者结合，学生既能享受灵活性，又不失指导。

questions.q: Supporters say online learning offers ______ and saves time.
Critics argue it lacks face-to-face ______ .
The writer thinks online learning works best as a ______ to classroom teaching.

sentences.en: It is often said that no one can succeed entirely on their own.
sentences.cn: 人们常说，没有人能完全靠自己成功。

sentences.en: Teamwork allows people to combine their different strengths.
sentences.cn: 团队合作让人们能够结合各自不同的长处。

sentences.en: When members share ideas, problems are solved more creatively.
sentences.cn: 当成员分享想法时，问题会得到更有创意的解决。

sentences.en: Moreover, working together builds trust and friendship.
sentences.cn: 而且，共同协作能建立信任和友谊。

sentences.en: Of course, good teamwork requires clear communication and respect.
sentences.cn: 当然，良好的团队合作需要清晰的沟通和尊重。

sentences.en: Each member should listen carefully and value others' opinions.
sentences.cn: 每个成员都应认真倾听、重视他人的意见。

sentences.en: In conclusion, teamwork is a key to achieving what individuals cannot.
sentences.cn: 总之，团队合作是实现个人无法完成之事的关键。

questions.q: Teamwork lets people combine their different ______ .
Good teamwork requires clear communication and ______ .
The writer concludes teamwork is a ______ to achieving more. (以 k 开头)

sentences.en: Tea has been a part of Chinese life for thousands of years.
sentences.cn: 茶已经是中国人生活的一部分，历时数千年。

sentences.en: According to legend, tea was discovered by an ancient emperor.
sentences.cn: 据传说，茶是由一位古代帝王发现的。

sentences.en: Today, there are many kinds of tea, such as green, black and oolong.
sentences.cn: 如今有许多种茶，如绿茶、红茶和乌龙茶。

sentences.en: Chinese people often serve tea to welcome guests and show respect.
sentences.cn: 中国人常以茶待客，以示尊重。

sentences.en: Drinking tea is believed to be good for health and helps people relax.
sentences.cn: 人们认为喝茶有益健康，还能帮助放松。

sentences.en: More than a drink, tea carries the value of harmony and politeness.
sentences.cn: 茶不仅是一种饮品，更承载着和谐与礼貌的价值。

questions.q: According to legend, tea was discovered by an ancient ______ .
Chinese people serve tea to welcome guests and show ______ .
Tea carries the value of ______ and politeness. (和谐)

sentences.en: The Mid-Autumn Festival falls on the fifteenth day of the eighth lunar month.
sentences.cn: 中秋节在农历八月十五。

sentences.en: On this day, the moon is believed to be at its roundest and brightest.
sentences.cn: 这一天，月亮被认为最圆最亮。

sentences.en: Family members gather together to admire the full moon.
sentences.cn: 家人团聚在一起赏满月。

sentences.en: Eating mooncakes is the most important custom of the festival.
sentences.cn: 吃月饼是这个节日最重要的习俗。

sentences.en: The round shape of the moon and mooncakes symbolizes reunion.
sentences.cn: 月亮和月饼的圆形象征着团圆。

sentences.en: People who are far from home also miss their families on this night.
sentences.cn: 远离家乡的人在这一夜也会思念家人。

questions.q: The most important custom is eating ______ .
The round shape symbolizes ______ .
The festival falls on the fifteenth day of the ______ lunar month. (第几，序数词)
